purpose: Reduce both spotlight opacities, keeping their sources at the top and preserving the opaque disco ball.

Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a transparent foreground overlay for a playing card. The user says the spotlights are much too opaque.
Make ONLY this correction: reduce the actual ALPHA OPACITY of BOTH the yellow and cyan spotlight cones by approximately 80%, including their broad halos. Keep the mirrored disco ball at upper-right crisp and fully opaque, preserving its size, mirror tiles, color and star glint. Do not fade the ball when fading the beams.
Output an actual transparent RGBA PNG with all empty space alpha zero. No opaque black backing, no colored fog filling the canvas, no gray or checkerboard background. No character, crowd, floor, lettering, extra objects, or scene. This is a normal alpha-over foreground overlay, NOT a black image intended for screen blending.
